target.role: fresh outward discovery for a distinct GROOVE OVER NOISE function
target.position: outside all frozen and protected regions; placement selected only after belonging
target.purpose: test whether fresh current, adjacent or emerging, and overlooked catalogue evidence reveals a distinct function without inventing a defect

explorationReceipt.scope: approximately 126 named track and release listings across 22 official release pages or bounded catalogue/search windows screened across all three required source families

currentReleases: 2026-07-01 through 2026-08-11 window; approximately 49 named tracks across eight official release pages and two bounded search windows
Official Analogue Network The Cycle release: https://analoguenetwork.bandcamp.com/album/the-cycle-an021
Official Sound Avenue Sweet Motion release: https://soundavenue.bandcamp.com/album/sweet-motion
adjacentAndEmerging: Approximately 46 named tracks across official UTCH, Sonic Perception, Sotor, Systolic and T&NE catalogue pages
overlookedCatalogue: Approximately 31 named tracks across five official catalogue pages and four bounded exact-track metadata searches
Official The Third Room Stone Techno Series Cubic EP: https://thethirdroom.bandcamp.com/album/stone-techno-series-cubic-ep
Beatport exact VNNN. Groove Attack metadata: https://www.beatport.com/track/groove-attack/15557080
Official Autonome Connor Wall Reduction release: https://autonomerecords.bandcamp.com/album/reduction

exclusions: Every lead and candidate from all earlier immutable requests was excluded, including both 2026-08-10 request sets.
All current ledger identities, durable rejected entries, frozen Session 4 material and untriggered PARKED revisit entries were excluded.

Current-release tracks were excluded when official descriptions emphasized peak-time impact, dense driving flow, high energy, pronounced melody or only broad release-level fit without a distinct restrained behaviour; no current-release lead met the shortlist floor.

Adjacent and emerging alternatives were excluded when only compilation-level genre language supported them, exact identity was too ambiguous, or their likely functions duplicated occupied re-entry, immersion and release stages.

Overlooked catalogue alternatives were excluded when they required touching the protected ending, splitting Deep Under to Wurk, entering Iruka to Percussion Work to Interlynx, or relied on impact, hooks or industrial pressure.
No lead was admitted for novelty, popularity, duration, BPM, artist reputation or quota completion.
explorationReceipt.evidenceLimit: Official release and exact retailer metadata plus attributed label descriptions only; no raw-audio analysis and no candidate-specific listener report.

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.

warnings.warning: Exact title/artist matched with release metadata variance: release date requested "2026-05-05" but Spotify returned "2026-05-14"

proposedPlacements.position: after F Track and before Octagon

requestedIdentity.fitHypothesis: UTCH frames the four-track release around restraint, continuity, reduced elements, subtle modulation and internal movement rather than dramatic shifts; Allure90 may provisionally belong, but the description is release-level and its proposed functions may already be occupied.

evidence.attributedDescription: UTCH describes the release as prioritizing structure over excess and immersion over immediate impact, with reduced elements, sustained low-end pressure, subtle modulation and continuity.
evidence.craftConvention: A candidate may deepen a wave or threshold only if exact identity and neighbour evaluation show a distinct function rather than another occupied shelf.

requestedIdentity.bpmSource: Beatport exact Groove Attack metadata, track id 15557080: 134 BPM, 5:18, released 2021-08-27
requestedIdentity.fitHypothesis: The Third Room specifically describes Groove Attack through hypnotic grooves for the late hours of an extensive musical journey, supporting provisional belonging; its low 134 BPM creates compliant but directionally awkward paths and may duplicate existing groove or threshold functions.

measured: 134 BPM from Beatport exact track metadata
evidence.attributedDescription: The Third Room says VNNN. hails with hypnotic grooves for the late hours of an extensive musical journey.
evidence.craftConvention: A compliant BPM path must still preserve directional progression and add a distinct journey function.
